subject: OrchardTrace x LexFlow - co-engineering integration plan & telemetry handoff
messages:
From: Elliot Barnes <elliot@orchardtrace.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@lexflow.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: OrchardTrace x LexFlow - tracing & prompt telemetry collaboration

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for taking this call yesterday. OrchardTrace builds lightweight prompt- and call-level tracing for ISVs, and LexFlow is exploring a first-class integration so customers using their SDK (LexFlow) can get token-attribution, prompt-hash lineage, and Redwood-ready trace payloads out of the box.

High-level ask: can Redwood commit a short co-eng to wire OrchardTrace tracing hooks into LexFlow SDK flows (open-source client + hosted runtime) so the telemetry emitted matches Redwood's "trace schema v2" and includes the following minimum fields: model_id, model_variant, sequence_length, prompt_hash, token_attribution_map, request_id, user_id (pseudonymized), latency_ms, and route_tag.

We'd love to do this in a 2-week sprint: week 1 - schema mapping + sandbox integration; week 2 - acceptance testing + rollout plan (canary + metrics). To make this concrete I can share a sample mapping and a sandbox token today.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Do you have a preferred envelope/event format (OTLP, JSON-Lines)?
- Any constraints on PII fields we should mask at the SDK level?
- Who owns runtime acceptance? (lexflow vs redwood)

I've CC'd Priya (LexFlow) to keep product/eng looped. Attaching a short acceptance criteria doc and checklist.

Attachments: orchardtrace-acceptance-criteria.md

Thanks —
Elliot Barnes
Director, Partnerships | OrchardTrace
elliot@orchardtrace.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@orchardtrace.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@lexflow.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrchardTrace x LexFlow - tracing & prompt telemetry collaboration

Elliot —

Appreciate the clear ask and the acceptance doc. We're aligned on doing a short co-eng. Vanessa (partnerships) and Marissa (platform integration) are looped — I've asked them to own their parts below.

Quick answers:
- Envelope: Redwood prefers OTLP over HTTP for production traces, but for SDK-stage testing JSON-Lines is fine. We'll provide a small shim to convert JSON-Lines -> OTLP in the sandbox.
- PII: Redwood requires user identifiers to be pseudonymized at the SDK level unless a customer opts-in. Please ensure lexflow SDK emits user_id_hash and exposes a redact/none option in configuration.
- Runtime acceptance: Redwood Platform (Marissa) will validate runtime telemetry, SLOs, and safety masking. LexFlow should own unit + integration tests in their SDK.

Proposed immediate scope (week 0 = prep):
1) Schema mapping doc (OrchardTrace -> Redwood trace_v2) — Elliot to provide by EOD Wed.
2) Sandbox creds + ephemeral endpoint — Redwood infra will spin a sandbox receiver; Mateo will request access.
3) LexFlow patch: add TraceAdapter interface + configuration flag (lexflow.tracing.orchard = true).
4) Acceptance criteria: message-level and token-level checks from orchardtrace-acceptance-criteria.md.

Deliverables by end of sprint: mapping doc, PR in lexflow/sdk, sandbox traces reaching Redwood's dev receiver, acceptance report.

I've attached our integration checklist (lexflow-integration-checklist.xlsx) with required test cases and a sample token attribution table. Vanessa — can you coordinate legal/commercial touchpoints? Marissa — will you run the runtime acceptance steps?

Thanks —
Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Elliot Barnes <elliot@orchardtrace.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@lexflow.ai>, eng+integration@lexflow.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrchardTrace x LexFlow - tracing & prompt telemetry collaboration

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 11:02 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Elliot —
> 
> Appreciate the clear ask and the acceptance doc. We're aligned on doing a short co-eng. Vanessa (partnerships) and Marissa (platform integration) are looped — I've asked them to own their parts below.

Thanks — all. Quick updates from our side:

1) Attached is our proposed mapping (orchardtrace->redwood_v2) and a short PR draft for LexFlow SDK showing TraceAdapter interface. We'll push a branch today: feature/trace-orchard-adapter.
2) Sandbox: attaching creds (sandbox_token: ORCH-SBX-abc123). Endpoint: https://sbx.orchardtrace.com/collector/jsonl (we'll support OTLP after initial test).
3) PII: LexFlow will implement user_id_hash by default and a redact config.

A couple asks for Redwood:
- Can you provide a small shim example to demonstrate JSON-Lines -> OTLP conversion in the sandbox? That will speed tests.
- Rollout: LexFlow prefers a phased enablement (alpha customers list -> canary for 2 days -> full). What are Redwood's canary rules for model route fallback if telemetry spikes?

Attachments: orchardtrace-acceptance-criteria.md (updated)

We'll be available for a 30-min sync tomorrow (Fri) 10:00-10:30 PST or Mon 09:00-09:30 PST. Which works for Redwood eng?

—Elliot
Elliot Barnes
Director, Partnerships | OrchardTrace

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@orchardtrace.com>, Priya Shah <priya@lexflow.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrchardTrace x LexFlow - tracing & prompt telemetry collaboration

Thanks, Elliot & Priya —

We reviewed your mapping and the acceptance doc. Next steps / owners and dates:

- Marissa (Platform) — run runtime acceptance and privacy validation (verify token_attribution, user_id_hash, model_id fields). Target: 2026-11-20.
- Mateo (SE) — coordinate sandbox connectivity and test runs; request infra spin-up. ETA: 2026-11-16.
- Vanessa (Partnerships) — commercial/contract language and data processing addendum (DPA) check. ETA: 2026-11-18.
- LexFlow / OrchardTrace — PRs for SDK + adapter branch into lexflow/sdk; provide integration test vectors and a small sample dataset for token attribution tests. ETA: branch by 2026-11-15.

I'll set up the 30-min sync for Monday 09:00 PST and include a short acceptance checklist in the calendar invite. For the canary rules: Redwood's standard is a 24–48 hour canary with token-rate and error-rate monitors; if telemetry ingestion error_rate > 2% for 10 minutes we automatically pause shipping of the instrumentation flag and fall back to no-op tracing for that customer route. We'll document that in the runbook shared via Drive (link below).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=123orchard

Thanks — looking forward.

Marissa Cole
Platform Integrations Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
